critique: The magenta-on-black palette remains related to the Form preset family, but this frame is now an extreme close-up of soft, smooth, parallel diagonal bands. It lacks the reference preset's intricate, distributed fractal-string texture: there is virtually no visible branching, turbulent breakup, or fine layered line structure. The far-left bands are heavily blown out and the field has little black-space separation, so it reads as blurred light streaks rather than Fractal Lines.

suggestions.why: Reducing String Size Random should suppress the oversized soft foreground strings that are currently turning the result into broad luminous bands.
Lower particle size will make individual strings substantially finer and allow gaps and fine fractal detail to remain visible instead of merging into thick streaks.
Reduccing maximum opacity will prevent the clipped, washed-out pink mass at the left and restore contrast between layered lines and the black background.
